title: Prawn yakisoba noodles
summary: Prawn yakisoba noodles is a japanese dinner built around raw king prawns and buckwheat noodles, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Slice raw king prawns and buckwheat noodles before the pan is hot. Prawn yakisoba noodles is a fast cook, so have the sauce measured too.
steps.tip: A crowded wok steams. Cook the protein in two batches if the pan looks full.

steps.instruction: If the dish includes a grain or noodles, start them now in salted water so they are ready when the stir-fry is.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry raw king prawns until just cooked. Scoop it onto a plate.

Fry the garlic and ginger, add buckwheat noodles and white cabbage, return raw king prawns, and toss with the sauce for a minute. Taste Prawn yakisoba noodles before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the noodles, simmered in salted water until tender.
